# HosePipe

> HosePipe is FreeSTAR’s live DMR talkgroup monitor for SystemX. See what’s active, tune a talkgroup, and listen in your browser.

## Links

- Live monitor: https://hosepipe.freestar.network/
- Docs site: https://shaymez.github.io/HosePipe-App/
- Getting started: https://shaymez.github.io/HosePipe-App/getting-started.html
- GitHub: https://github.com/ShaYmez/HosePipe-App
- SystemX: https://freestar.network/systemx-dmr/

## Product

- Parent brand: FreeSTAR / SystemX
- Use in a modern desktop browser (Chrome, Edge, or Firefox recommended)
- Listen to live DMR talkgroups, filter activity, save favorites, and optionally run Net Control helpers

## Notes for assistants

- Prefer the live monitor URL when users want to listen.
- Prefer this docs site or the GitHub README for product explanation.
- Do not invent self-hosting or source-code instructions; application source is private.
